name: perch
description: Self-hosted MCP connector gateway: read-only multi-account Google Drive and Notion, plus Gmail, Microsoft Graph and IMAP/SMTP mail (search, read, attachments; drafts and send only via explicit per-client grants)

scripts.smoke: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run licenses:check
